color.description: A colour. Components are IEEE 754 binary32 values written in decimal.

model.description: The colour model. One of: `rgb` (red, green, blue); `cmyk` (cyan, magenta, yellow, black inks); `gray` (black ink only); `lab` (CIE L*a*b*).

color_cmyk.description: A CMYK colour: ink amounts in the document's CMYK space.

color_gray.description: A gray: an amount of black ink.

color_lab.description: A CIE L*a*b* colour, D50 white point (device independent; how spot colours are defined).

color_rgb.description: An RGB colour (sRGB unless the document names another RGB profile).

node_id.description: The node_id of a node of this package.

object_id.description: The `id` of an object in one of the document's layers.

point.description: A point in the space the field's description names, in points (1/72 inch); x grows right, y grows down.

script_metrics.description: The size and position of superscript or subscript characters.

position.description: Baseline offset in percent of the font size: up for superscript, down for subscript.

size.description: Glyph size in percent of the font size.

description: The structure of the document: which nodes are its artboards and layers and in what order, the tables that name its other units, and the settings that belong to no unit. It carries no art.

artboards.description: The artboards, in order (the first is the one the preview shows).

color_mode.description: The document's colour mode: the model new colours take and the space transparency is blended in. One of: `Rgb` (the default); `Cmyk`.

color_profiles.description: The colour profiles the document is tagged with, by name. The ICC files themselves, when they could be embedded, are listed in the x.vectorcraft.embedded node.

cmyk.description: Name of the CMYK profile. Absent: the reader's working CMYK space.

rgb.description: Name of the RGB profile. Absent: sRGB.

fonts.description: The fonts of the document's type: one row per face the type uses, embedded or not. Absent: none.

items.description: A font face the document's type is set in.

face_index.description: The face's index in its font file (a collection holds several). Absent: 0.

family.description: Family name, as in `font_family` of a run.

reason.description: Why the font is not embedded, in words (`status` says it for a program).

source.description: The node with the font file (TrueType / OpenType), verbatim. Absent: the font is not embedded; `status` and `reason` say why.

status.description: `embedded`: `source` names the node with the font file. Otherwise the font is not in the file: `restricted` (the Restricted License embedding bit of its OS/2 `fsType`, or its bitmap-only bit, forbids embedding), `missing` (it was not installed, as a TrueType / OpenType file, where the document was saved), `not-requested` (the writer was told not to embed fonts). Absent (a writer that does not say): `embedded` when `source` is present, unknown otherwise.

fonts_not_embedded.description: True: the document was saved with font embedding turned off. Absent: false.

graphic_styles.description: The core.vector.styles node. Absent: no graphic styles.

spacing.description: Distance between grid lines in points.

guides.description: Ruler guides (shown in an editor, never printed). Absent: none.

artboard.description: The `id` of the artboard the guide belongs to (it runs across that artboard only). Absent: across the whole canvas.

layer.description: The layer or sublayer the guide is on. Absent: on no layer.

pos.description: The guide's coordinate in document points.

vertical.description: True: a vertical guide at x = `pos`; false: a horizontal guide at y = `pos`.

items.description: The ICC file of a profile the document is tagged with.

source.description: The node with the ICC profile, verbatim.

images.description: The document's images: one entry per image key. Absent: none.

key.description: The key image objects and placed documents name the image by.

mime.description: The media type of the image's own bytes. Absent: `image/png`.

node.description: The core.vector.image node: the image's pixels as a PNG, which any reader shows. Absent: the pixels could not be had (the image then draws nothing in a reader that cannot decode `original`).

original.description: The node with the image's own bytes, verbatim, in the encoding its node type defines (JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, or a placed document). The PNG of `node` was decoded from it. Absent: the image's own bytes are the PNG of `node`.

layers.description: The top-level layers, BOTTOM FIRST: each paints over the ones before it.

authorTitle.description: The author's position or job title.

copyrightUrl.description: Where to read more about the copyright.

created.description: When the document was created. Null: not recorded.

keywords.description: Keywords, in the order they were added.

modified.description: When the document was last saved. Null: not recorded.

model_version.description: The revision of VectorCraft's document model the payloads were written from: 1. Absent: 1.

next_object_id.description: A number above every object id the document has ever used: the next object gets this id. Absent: one above the largest id in the layers.

page_isolate.description: True: the page is an isolated transparency group (top-level blend modes do not blend with what is under the page). Absent: false.

page_knockout.description: True: the page's top-level layers knock each other out. Absent: false.

patterns.description: The document's patterns, in order. Absent: none.

items.description: A pattern and the node that holds it.

name.description: The pattern's name, repeated from its node's payload so the list can be shown without opening the node.

addAround.description: Extra room around the art in points. Absent: 36.

antiAlias.description: Smooth the art's edges. Absent: true.

background.description: What lies behind effect images. One of: `transparent` (they keep their transparency); `white` (they are opaque, on white; the default).

clippingMask.description: Clip an effect image to the art's outline. Absent: false.

colorModel.description: The colour model of effect images. One of: `document` (the document's colour mode; the default); `grayscale`; `bitmap` (black and white pixels only).

preserveSpotColors.description: Keep spot colours in raster effects. Absent: true.

raster_effects_ppi.description: Resolution at which raster effects (blurs, shadows) are computed, in pixels per inch. Absent: 72.

ruler_origin.description: The zero point of an editor's rulers, in document coordinates. Absent: (0, 0).

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

background.description: The artboards' background. One of: `transparent` (the default); `white` (raster exports are opaque white there).

bleed.description: Bleed beyond every artboard edge in points: top, bottom, left, right.

discardWhiteOverprint.description: Discard overprint of white objects in output.

exportText.description: How exports write type. One of: `editable` (as text; the default); `appearance` (as glyph outlines).

flattenerPreset.description: Name of the transparency flattener preset for output that cannot keep transparency. Null: the application's default.

gridColors.description: The two colours of the transparency grid; the first is also the simulated paper colour.

gridSize.description: Cell size of the transparency grid an editor shows. One of: `small`; `medium` (the default); `large`.

highlightSubstitutedFonts.description: Editor: highlight type whose font is missing.

highlightSubstitutedGlyphs.description: Editor: highlight glyphs the font lacks.

language.description: The document's language, by the application's name for it (for example `English: USA`).

outlineImages.description: Editor: show images in outline mode.

quotes.description: The typographer's quotes of the language.

simulatePaper.description: Editor: artboards show the paper colour and art is multiplied onto it.

smallCapsSize.description: Size of synthesized small capitals, percent of the font size.

spot_use_lab.description: True: spot colours defined in Lab are shown from their Lab values; false: from their CMYK equivalents. Absent: true.

swatches.description: The core.paint.swatches node. Absent: the document has no swatches.

symbols.description: The document's symbols, in panel order. Absent: none.

items.description: A symbol and the node that holds it.

name.description: The symbol's name, repeated from its node's payload so the list can be shown without opening the node.

template.description: True: the file is a template (opening it starts a new untitled document). Absent: false.

text_styles.description: The core.text.styles node. Absent: no text styles.

text_threads.description: Threaded text: each entry is one story flowing through several frames. Absent: none.

items.description: The area type objects one story flows through, in order.

units.description: The unit an editor DISPLAYS measurements in. Every number in the file is in points regardless. One of: `Points` (1/72 inch); `Picas` (12 points); `Inches`; `Millimeters`; `Centimeters`; `Pixels` (1 pixel = 1 point); `FeetInches` (feet and inches); `Meters`; `Yards`; `Feet`.

title: core.vector.document - the structure node of a vector-art/1 document
